translationResources.title: Histogram
translationResources.description: The distribution of raw samples in bins of equal width, from a few hundred values to millions.

latency.title: Latency distribution
latency.description: One million request latencies binned in a few milliseconds; quantiles gives the exact p50, p95 and p99, drawn as x reference lines.

binning.title: Binning rules
binning.description: bins takes a count or a rule: auto (Freedman-Diaconis, robust to outliers), sturges (log2 n + 1) or a fixed number; the two groups of levels appear with enough bins.

ages.title: Fixed bins
ages.description: A domain and a count give round bins, one per 5 years here; formatBin writes the edges in the tooltip, typed arrays are binned without copies.

comparison.title: Comparing two samples
comparison.description: histogramSeries builds the bars of a sample: with the same domain and count, two samples share their bins and sit side by side in a Chart.

quality-control.title: Process capability
quality-control.description: Diameters of machined parts against their tolerance: rect and line annotations mark the specification limits and the series prop draws the fitted normal curve over the bins. The readout computes the Cpk, and the switch shows the process once the tool is adjusted.

order-values.title: Order values on a log scale
order-values.description: Order values spanning three orders of magnitude are binned on their logarithm, so each bin covers the same ratio; formatBin and xAxis.format turn the edges back into dollars. Annotations mark the median, the p99 and the orders that qualify for free shipping.

live-samples.title: Live sliding window
live-samples.description: Wait times of the last 600 support calls, updated twice a second by a setInterval that is cleared on pause and unmount. A fixed domain, bin count and yAxis range keep the axes still while the distribution shifts, and the readout tracks the service level.

commute.title: Cumulative share on click
commute.description: onPointClick gives the index of the clicked bin; binValues, called with the same options, returns its edges and counts to compute the share of employees at or below it. renderTooltip shows the count and share of each bin, and onPlotClick clears the selection.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: 5,000 ages counted into 14 bins of 5 years; the tooltip shows the range and the count of the touched bin.

HistogramChartProps.values: Raw samples (typed arrays are counted without copies)
HistogramChartProps.name: Name of the counts (legend, tooltip)
HistogramChartProps.formatBin: Formats the edges of the bins in the tooltip
HistogramChartProps.series: More series drawn over the bins (e.g. a density line)

BinOptions.bins: Number of bins, or the rule choosing it: "auto" (Freedman-Diaconis, Sturges when the spread is zero), "sturges" or "freedman-diaconis"
BinOptions.domain: Range covered by the bins (values outside are not counted); the data range by default
BinOptions.nice: Rounds the bin width to 1, 2 or 5 × 10^k and aligns the edges on it

HistogramBins.edges: Edges of the bins: one more than the bins
HistogramBins.counts: Number of values in every bin
HistogramBins.total: Number of values counted (finite, inside the domain)

latency.title: Response time distribution
latency.description: 5,000 raw samples binned by the chart (Freedman-Diaconis): the long tail of slow requests shows at once.

binning.title: Binning rules
binning.description: The same ages in Sturges bins, 10 or 40 bins: the two groups of customers appear with enough bins.

props.valueName: Name of the value in the tooltip
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
